name: com.antideploy/antideploy-mcp
title: Antideploy
description: Deploy and run apps on Antideploy from a coding agent. Sign in with one link; no dashboard, Dockerfile or YAML.

environmentVariables.name: ANTIDEPLOY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. A project key for one application, from the console, starting with ad_. Leave it out and use the login tool instead.

environmentVariables.name: ANTIDEPLOY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Antideploy instance. Defaults to https://antideploy.com. Only set for a self-hosted or staging instance.
